segments.name: Logistics and fulfillment
segments.description: Provides thermal management logistics and fulfillment to the life sciences industry, including emergency response, specialty packaging and monitoring.
segments.evidence: To date, the Company has viewed its operations and manages its business as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for logistics, emergency response, packaging and monitoring services for shipments of life sciences products.
revenueModel.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, our top three customers, the Customer 1 (58%), Customer 2 (10%), and Customer 3 (11%), collectively accounted for approximately 79% of our revenue.
